detail: The shakes' carbohydrate (7.1-9.8 g from juice) and protein (45.3-45.5 g) are printed in Table 1 but their fat is printed nowhere, and the stated 233.5 kcal does not follow from carbohydrate and protein at 4 kcal/g, so the meal's fat_g cannot be written without assuming it; the time courses are in Figures 2 and 3 only and the iAUC units are not printed.
